parameters.help_en: The call center ID
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The unique agent ID. The ID must be 4 to 11 digits in length
parameters.help_zh: 座席工号，4-11位数字，要求唯一
parameters.name: cno

parameters.help_en: The agent name. The name can contain only Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores (_), and can be up to 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 座席名称，只允许输入中文，字母，数字，下划线，长度不超过 20 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The area code
parameters.help_zh: 所属区号
parameters.name: area_code

parameters.help_en: The agent password. The password is encrypted by using AES and is 8 characters in length by default. If password security settings are enabled for the enterprise, the password must be set based on the configured rules
parameters.help_zh: 座席密码，采用 AES加密 ，默认长度为 8 位。如果企业开启了密码安全设置，则需要按照设置的规则设置
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
The agent role. Valid values:
0: regular agent
1: supervisor
parameters.help_zh: 座席角色，0: 普通座席；1: 班长座席
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en:
The activation status. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled
parameters.help_zh: 启用状态， 0: 停用；1: 启用
parameters.name: active

parameters.help_en: The queue numbers
parameters.help_zh: 所属队列号集合
parameters.name: qnos

parameters.help_en:
The phone number masking type. Valid values:
0: do not mask
1: follow global settings
parameters.help_zh: 号码隐藏类型，0: 不隐藏；1: 隐藏规则与全局设置保持一致
parameters.name: hidden_tel

parameters.help_en:
The inbound wrap-up type. Valid values:
1: queue
2: agent
parameters.help_zh: 呼入整理类型，1：队列；2：座席
parameters.name: ib_wrapup_type

parameters.help_en: The inbound wrap-up time. This is the after-call processing time for an agent after an inbound call ends. During this period, the agent does not receive new inbound calls. Valid values: 0 to 3600. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 呼入整理时长，客户来电座席接听，双方通话结束后座席的话后处理时长，此期间座席不接收新的客户来电。取值范围：0～3600秒
parameters.name: ib_wrapup_time

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time. This is the after-call processing time for an agent after an outbound call ends. Valid values: 0 to 300. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 整理时长，座席进行外呼操作后的整理时间，取值范围 0-300 秒
parameters.name: wrapup_time

parameters.help_en: The CRM ID. This ID can be used as a unique identifier when integrating with a third-party CRM system
parameters.help_zh: CRM 编号，与第三方 CRM 系统对接时，可作为唯一标识
parameters.name: crm_id

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID type. Valid values:
0: all
2: specified by agent
3: smart caller ID
parameters.help_zh: 外显号码类型，0: 全部；2: 座席指定；3: 智能外显
parameters.name: clid_type

parameters.help_en:
The number type. Valid values:
0: number
1: dynamic number group
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 号码类型，默认值为0，0: 号码；1: 动态号码组
parameters.name: assign_type

parameters.help_en: The dynamic number group name. This parameter is required when AssignType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 动态号码组名称，当assignType（号码类型）值为1（动态号码组）时为必填项
parameters.name: dynamic_tel_group_name

parameters.help_en:
The caller ID rule. Valid values when ClidType is set to 0:
1: random
2: round-robin
Valid values when ClidType is set to 3:
1: dynamic
2: custom
parameters.help_zh: 外显规则， 当clidType（外显号码类型）值为0（全部）时，1:随机；2: 轮选。 当clidType（外显号码类型）值为3（智能外显）时，1:动态；2: 自定义
parameters.name: clid_rule

parameters.help_en: The available caller IDs. This parameter is required when the caller ID type is not set to all
parameters.help_zh: 可外显号码集合，当外显类型非全部时需指定此参数值
parameters.name: clid

parameters.help_en: The default caller IDs. This parameter is supported when ClidType is set to 3 and ClidRule is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 缺省外显号码集合，当clidType（外显号码类型）值为3且clidRule（外显规则）值为1（动态）时，支持配置缺省外显
parameters.name: clid_default

fields.help_en:
The number type. Valid values:
0: number
1: dynamic number group
Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 号码类型，默认值为0，0: 号码；1: 动态号码组
fields.name: assign_type

fields.help_en: The dynamic number group name. This parameter is required when AssignType is set to 1
fields.help_zh: 动态号码组名称，当assignType（号码类型）值为1（动态号码组）时为必填项
fields.name: dynamic_tel_group_name

parameters.help_en: The region-based caller ID configuration. This parameter takes effect when ClidType is set to 3 and ClidRule is set to 2. For specific configuration items, see the ClidArea object
parameters.help_zh: 按地区外显配置，当clidType（外显号码类型）值为3且clidRule（外显规则）值为2（自定义）时有意义，具体配置项见 clidArea 对象
parameters.name: clid_area

parameters.help_en:
The round-robin mode. This parameter takes effect when the caller ID type is set to all and the caller ID rule is set to round-robin. Valid values:
1: daily round-robin
2: per-call round-robin
parameters.help_zh: 轮选方式，1: 按天轮选；2: 按次轮选，当外显号码类型为全部、外显规则为轮选时配置才生效
parameters.name: recurrentselection_type

parameters.help_en: The round-robin value. This parameter takes effect when the caller ID type is set to all and the caller ID rule is set to round-robin. When RecurrentselectionType is set to 1, the caller ID is changed every N days. Valid values: 1 to 30. When RecurrentselectionType is set to 2, the caller ID is changed every N calls. Valid values: 1 to 30
parameters.help_zh: 轮选值设置，当外显号码类型为全部、外显规则为轮选时配置才生效 1: 按天轮选，每 n 天外呼更换一次外显号码，可设置 1-30 天 2: 按次轮选，每 n 次外呼更换一次外显号码，可设置 1-30 次
parameters.name: recurrentselection_value

fields.help_en:
The speech transcription permission. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled for inbound calls
2: enabled for outbound calls
3: enabled for all calls
Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 语音转写，0: 关闭；1: 呼入开启；2 外呼开启；3 全部开启；默认值为 0
fields.name: asr

fields.help_en:
The outbound call permission. Valid values:

1: unrestricted

3: domestic local calls
fields.help_zh: 外呼权限，0:关闭；1: 无限制；2: 国内长途；3: 国内本地
fields.name: call

fields.help_en:
The CDR viewing permission. Valid values:
1: all
2: assigned queues
3: current agent
fields.help_zh: 通话记录查看权限，1: 全部；2: 所属队列；3: 本座席
fields.name: cdr

fields.help_en:
The chat session record viewing permission. Valid values:
0: all
1: assigned queues
2: current agent
Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 在线客服查看会话记录权限 ，0：全部、1：所属队列、2：本座席； 默认值为 0
fields.name: chat

fields.help_en:
The other data viewing permission. Valid values:
1: all
2: assigned agent group
3: current agent
4: specified agent group
Default value: 2
fields.help_zh: 其他数据查看权限：1：全部 2：所属员工组 3：自己 4:指定员工组 ,默认所属员工组
fields.name: other_data

fields.help_en: The permission for call recording. Valid values: 0: Disabled. 1: Inbound calls. 2: Outbound calls. 3: All
fields.help_zh: 通话录音权限，0: 关闭；1: 呼入；2: 外呼；3: 全部
fields.name: record

fields.help_en:
The recording playback and download permission. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: playback only
2: playback and download
fields.help_zh: 录音试听下载权限， 0: 关闭；1: 试听；2: 试听下载
fields.name: record_download

fields.help_en:
The SMS sending permission. Valid values:
0: disabled
1: enabled
Default value: 0
fields.help_zh: 短信发送权限，0: 关闭；1: 开启。默认值为 0
fields.name: sms

fields.help_en: The permission to view outbound tasks. Valid values: 1: All. 3: Self. Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 外呼任务查看权限，1：全部 3：自己，默认全部
fields.name: task_inventory

fields.help_en:
The call transfer and consultation permission. Valid values:
0: all
1: assigned agent group
Default value: 1
fields.help_zh: 通话转移/咨询权限，可选范围，0：全部，1：所属员工组, 默认所属员工组

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable RTC for WeChat mini programs. Valid values: 1: Enabled. 0: Disabled. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 微信小程序RTC开关 1：开启 0：关闭 默认关闭
parameters.name: wechat_mini_program_rtc

parameters.help_en: The default number type. Valid values: 0: Number. 1: Dynamic number group. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 缺省号码类型 0：号码 1：动态号码组 默认0
parameters.name: ob_clid_default_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the default dynamic outbound group. This parameter is required when ObClidDefaultType is set to 1
parameters.help_zh: 缺省动态外呼组id，当obClidDefaultType值为1时为必填项
parameters.name: dynamic_tel_group_id_default

parameters.help_en: The service areas of agents, represented as an array of area codes. You can configure the service areas for agents, which can be used in the assign-by-service-area policy for outbound tasks
parameters.help_zh: 座席服务地区，区号数组 配置座席服务的地区，可用于外呼任务中“按服务地区分配”的策略
parameters.name: serve_area

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable outbound calls by using cloud numbers. Valid values: 0: Disabled. 1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh: 云号码外呼开关，0-关，1-开
parameters.name: cloud_number_enabled

parameters.help_en: The four call modes for cloud numbers. The array length is 4, which corresponds to the enabling status of the four outbound call modes for cloud numbers in sequence: physical card, work card, two-way call, and RTC. For example, [0,0,0,1] indicates that agents can only use the RTC outbound call mode. Note: You can set this property for agents only when the enterprise has enabled the cloud phone outbound call feature. Otherwise, the agent creation fails
parameters.help_zh: 云号码四种呼叫模式；数组长度 为 4，依次对应云号码外呼的四种模式（实体卡、工作卡、两端呼、RTC)的开启状态； 例如：[0,0,0,1] 表示 座席只可使用 RTC 外呼模式。 注意：仅当企业开启了云手机外呼功能，才能为座席设置该属性，否则，座席将创建失败
parameters.name: cloud_number_modes

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the hang-up SMS feature for outbound calls. Valid values: 0: Disabled. 1: Enabled. After this feature is enabled, when an agent initiates an outbound call, the system sends an SMS message based on the configurations in SMS Center > SMS Settings > Outbound Call Answered Notification or Outbound Call Unanswered Notification
parameters.help_zh: 外呼挂机短信开关 0：关闭， 1：开启。开启后，当座席发起外呼时，系统会依据【短信中心 - 短信设置 - 外呼双方接听通知 / 外呼客户未接听通知】中的配置条件发送短信
parameters.name: ob_hangup_sms

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to allow agents to log on in the busy state. If this feature is disabled, agents are not allowed to log on in the busy state. Valid values: 0: Disabled. 1: Enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否可置忙登录，关闭后，座席不允许置忙登录，0：关闭，1：开启
parameters.name: pause_login
